ammonia.reason: Low ureolysis/deamination in natural rind uncooked pressed paste; increases in vieux

animal_barnyard.reason: p-cresol, indole and skatole from pasture-fed raw Aubrac milk and rind flora

bitter.reason: Hydrophobic peptides from rennet/chymosin and plasmin proteolysis during 4-12 mo aging

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation; only trace methyl ketones from wild molds

browning.reason: Maillard between residual amino acids and trace lactose/galactose on heating for aligot

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from Leuconostoc citrate metabolism retained in uncooked curd

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Butanoic/hexanoic/octanoic acids from rennet paste and raw-milk lipase lipolysis

creaminess.reason: 45% fat in dry matter smoothed by proteolysis but limited by 58-62% dry matter firm paste

crumbliness.reason: Acid salted-curd demineralization and long pressing give friable aged texture

firmness.reason: Uncooked pressed, salted in curd, >=58% dry matter and 4+ months ripening

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from ethanol + free fatty acids by nonstarter lactobacilli esterification

goaty.reason: Cow milk lacks high caproic/caprylic/capric waxy acids of goat milk

malty_nutty.reason: 3-methylbutanal/2-methylbutanal from leucine/isoleucine Strecker degradation, hazelnut note

melt.reason: pH ~5.4 demineralized rennet curd flows well when young; classic for aligot

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol/geosmin from natural brushed rind Brevibacterium/fungi surface flora

oil_off.reason: Moderate free fat release on heating from uncooked high-fat network

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic acid ~15g/kg from Lactococcus lactis plus acetic acid from heterofermenters

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata hot-water kneading; rennet gel does not align into fibers

sulfur_cooked.reason: Low methanethiol/dimethyl sulfide from methionine catabolism; milk not cooked

sweet.reason: Lactose exhausted; faint sweetness from glycerol, free amino acids and diacetyl masking

umami.reason: Glutamate accumulation by Lactobacillus proteolysis during extended affinage
